summary: CRT initialization stub with three unconditional subroutine calls. Calls InitCRTFloatConversionFunctionPointers, stores the return value of sub_58BCA6 into global dword_8D3E44, calls TwoArgCallWrapper, clears pending x87 FPU exception flags with fnclex, and returns the TwoArgCallWrapper result. No guards and no frame-path evidence.

operations.description: InitCRTFloatConversionFunctionPointers() configures the CRT float conversion function pointers.
sub_58BCA6() runs and produces the value that is stored into the CRT result global.
dword_8D3E44 = return value of sub_58BCA6(); the global is written with the call result.
TwoArgCallWrapper() runs and its return value is propagated as the function result.
fnclex clears the x87 FPU exception flags before returning.

unresolved: Purpose and consumer of the value stored in dword_8D3E44 is unknown; the global is written here but its readers are not in this packet.
Why fnclex is issued and what x87 exception state is being cleared is not documented here.
The arguments and role of TwoArgCallWrapper are caller/CRT defined and absent from this packet.
